summary: Web-based focus tracker with productivity timer and distraction logging features
architectural_notes: React frontend with Motoko backend on Internet Computer
No auto-start: user manually controls session start/stop
Classification dictionary for productive vs distracting apps/sites
Pattern detection algorithm tracks transition frequency and session duration

existing_features.title: Remove automatic focus session start on app launch - users must manually initiate sessions from the dashboard
Implement customizable productivity timer with preset and custom work/break intervals (Pomodoro-style)
Create manual distraction logging interface where users can record interruptions during focus sessions and categorize them by source (YouTube, Instagram, work apps, etc.)
Build activity classification system in backend that categorizes apps/websites as productive or distracting based on user-defined rules
Implement transition tracking to record sequences of activity switches (e.g., VS Code → YouTube) and identify interruption patterns
Create session history and analytics dashboard showing past focus sessions, distraction patterns, and most frequent interruption sources over time
Implement burnout/fatigue scoring algorithm based on switching frequency between productive and distracting activities with weighted penalties for context switches
Measure and display session duration metrics to distinguish between real work (25+ min), browsing (5-10 min), and checking habits (10-40 sec repeated visits)

new_feature_requests.summary: Productivity timer with customizable work/break intervals
Manual distraction logging with category selection
Transition tracking to identify interruption patterns
Burnout/fatigue scoring based on switching behavior
